Definition: a prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb δάω (to learn); to teach (in the same broad application):--teach.
BiblicalUsage: To teach is the work Jesus did everywhere He went, and the word follows Him from the synagogue to the mountain to the temple. He teaches in the synagogues of Galilee, He sits down and teaches the multitudes, and He promises the Spirit will teach His disciples all things.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe teaching is the heart of Jesus' ministry. He did not only heal and feed; He taught, and the teaching is what the church still lives by, because His words are spirit and life.
